pairs.ch: 有個實驗室的研究人員正在研究不同的調味料。(There is....)
pairs.en: There is a lab where researchers are studying different flavorings.

pairs.ch: Julia 用豐富的想像力編輯故事，這為他帶來成功的寫作事業。(..., which....)
pairs.en: Julia wove stories with her rich imagination, which brought her a successful writing career.

pairs.ch: 政府需要做的就是努力克服貧窮所造成的障礙。(What....)
pairs.en: What the government needs to do is try hard to overcome the obstacles caused by poverty.

pairs.ch: 那個女孩在遊行中要求人們為地球立即行動，這使她成為網路上的熱門話題(trending topic)。(..., which....)
pairs.en: The girl requested people to spring into action for the earth during the parade, which made her a trending topic online.

pairs.ch: 那個網紅(influencer)試圖做的是持續傳達正確的資訊，這位他贏得了娛樂圈的尊重。(What....; ..., which....)
pairs.en: What the influencer tries to do is convey correct information consistently, which has earned him respect in the entertainment industry.

pairs.ch: 三個人被困在建築物裡。一個受了重傷，另一個被嚇到並哭泣，還有一個試圖保持冷靜並呼救。
pairs.en: Three people were trapped in the building. One was seriously injured, another was scared and crying, and the other tried to stay calm and called for help.

pairs.ch: 許多觀眾發現這場演講既具啟發性又富有哲學意涵。(find + O + adj.)
pairs.en: Many audience members found the speech both inspiring and philosophical.

pairs.ch: 這場疾病讓 Herry 在醫院住了六個星期。(keep + O + prep.)
pairs.en: The illness kept Herry in the hospital for six weeks.

pairs.ch: 真令人驚訝，這場活動吸引了許多名人和籌辦者。(It...)
pairs.en: It is amazing that the event attracted many celebrities and organizers.

pairs.ch: 令人印象深刻的是，他在研討會中分享了他如何發行這個系列。(It...)
pairs.en: It is impressive that he shared how he published the series at the seminar.

pairs.ch: 不幸的是這場研討會籌劃不當，使許多與會者感到困惑和沮喪。(It...)
pairs.en: It is unfortunate that the seminar was poorly organized, leaving many participants confused and frustrated.

pairs.ch: 預測到一場猛烈的暴風雨，村民們急著趕往最近的避難所。(V-ing/p.p...., S + V....)
pairs.en: Predicting a violent storm, the villagers hurried to the nearest shelter.

pairs.ch: 在問題被揭發之後，那名男子似乎別無選擇只能辭掉工作。(it....)
pairs.en: After the problem was revealed, it seemed that the man had no choice but to quit his job.

pairs.ch: Peggy 似乎不再猶豫在公開場合表達自己的真實感受。(it....)
pairs.en: It appears that Peggy no longer hesitates to express her true feelings in public.

pairs.ch: 當冬天結束時，許多動物已成為嚴寒天氣的受害者。
pairs.en: By the time winter ended, many animals had fallen victim to the freezing weather.

pairs.ch: 從那天起，Jerry 不僅每天練習鋼琴，還提升了她的樂理知識。
pairs.en: From that day on, Jerry not only practiced the piano every day but also improved her knowledge of music theory.
